name: search_breweries
description: Search for breweries by name. Returns location, phone, website, and contact details for matching results.

query.description: Brewery name or partial name to search for

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 50)

name: get_brewery
description: Fetch full details for a single brewery by its Open Brewery DB UUID. Returns name, type, street address, city, state, postal code, country, GPS coordinates, phone, and website URL.

name: breweries_by_city
description: Find all breweries in a city (e.g., "Portland", "Denver"). Returns location, type, and contact details for each.

city.description: City name to search breweries in (e.g., "Portland", "Denver")

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 50)
